description: P0 cross-layer MoSim run manifest. This schema is documented for tooling; Scripts/quality/check_run_manifest.py implements the active validation.
p0_required_checks: ros2.fast_lio_eval.position_rmse_m <= 0.5 when FAST-LIO is in claim_scope
ros2.fast_lio_eval.max_error_m <= 1.0 when FAST-LIO is in claim_scope
planner.setpoint_trace_source == RUNTIME_20HZ_ADAPTER when planner/controller loop is in claim_scope
planner.setpoint_adapter_status == pass when planner/controller loop is in claim_scope
planner.setpoint_rate_hz >= 19 when planner/controller loop is in claim_scope
planner.stale_command_timeout_s > 0 when planner/controller loop is in claim_scope
mworks.setpoint_trace_consumption_status == pass when closed_loop is in claim_scope
mworks.consumed_setpoint_trace exists and matches planner.setpoint_trace when closed_loop is in claim_scope
mworks.trace_consumption_evidence is present when closed_loop is in claim_scope
